en: The black-and-white postcard depicts several people standing on logs floating in the water, using poles to maneuver them. The scene is set in a lush, tree-filled landscape with a small wooden building visible in the background. The foreground and sides are delineated by foliage and trees, suggesting a river or stream in a rural or forested area. The text on the postcard reads 'Liden. Timmerflottning.'
